text:
Elena: Quick sync  launching Compass Bench: webinar + benchmark narrative. Need X + LinkedIn schedule, hero image, GIF card, 15s + 30s clips, 3 caption variants, A/B headlines, and inbound lead routing. Can we lock timelines today?

Marcus: Yep. Webinar is June 30 2026, 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET. Proposed cadence: teaser 48h prior, live posts at T+5, follow-up w/ clip next day, community repost 3 days later.

Priya: Ill draft captions: A=stat-first, B=customer-quote, C=how-to. Also doing 2 headline variants for A/B. Dropping drafts in Notion in 30.

Theo: Design can do hero + GIF + clips. Any required specs? Also can make an IG-style 1:1 crop for community posts.

Ken: For inbound routing: registration -> HubSpot form -> enrichment -> Salesforce lead creation -> Slack notify #sdr-queue. Recommend tag compass_jun30 and lead_source=social. I can post the Zap recipe once tested.

Marcus: Ops schedule draft (will add timezone variants):
```
June 28 09:00 PT - X teaser (single image + short caption)
June 30 11:05 PT - X launch thread (headline + 3 replies)
June 30 11:15 PT - LinkedIn company post (long-form)
July 1 09:00 PT - X follow-up + 30s clip
July 3 10:00 PT - Community repost (1:1 image + short blurb)
```
Hold publishes until assets + captions are confirmed.

Elena: UTMs: utm_source=social, utm_medium=x|linkedin, utm_campaign=compass_jun30, utm_content=headlineA|headlineB. Shorten via /r/t/compass (internal redirect). Pinned reply should have TL;DR + register link + speaker names.

Priya: Notion link -> https://notion.so/redwood/compass-captions (placeholder). Added 3 caption lengths, 2 A/B headlines, and 3 CTA phrasings.

Theo: Specs: X hero 1600x900, LinkedIn 1200x627, GIF card 800x418, clips 1920x1080 mp4 H.264 (15s and 30s), 1:1 crop 1080x1080. Filenames: compass_hero_<platform>_v1.png, compass_gif_card_v1.gif, compass_clip_15s_v1.mp4.

Theo: Will upload assets to /marketing/assets/compass. ETA tomorrow 5pm PT. Also adding subtitled SRT for clips and transcript for repurposing.

Ken: Zap tested in sandbox. Flow: form -> Clearbit enrichment -> HubSpot create -> Salesforce create -> Slack notify #sdr-queue with payload: "Compass lead: {name} | score:{score} | tag:compass_jun30". Setting auto-priority flag for company_employee_count>50.

Elena: Also want DM templates to registrants: 1) day-after (thanks + replay), 2) 3-day nurture (resource + demo CTA). Can someone pen those?

Marcus: I can write DM/email templates and community repost blurb. Will coordinate copy with Priya.

Priya: Added short DM templates to Notion and two nurture email subject lines. Also created suggested hashtags and timing notes for APAC/EU windows.

Theo: Assets uploaded -> https://storage.redwood/assets/compass (placeholder). Confirm sizes and filenames match conv. GIF optimized under 3MB. Clips include burned-in captions and separate SRT.

Ken: Zap is live in test mode with Sales permissions confirmed. Slack notify format sample: "New Compass lead: Maya Park | score:58 | tag:compass_jun30".

Elena: Great. A couple extras: 1) Run A/B headlines on X headlines only (we'll pick winner after 4h). 2) Add a pinned comment with TL;DR + direct register link + one-sentence benchmark stat. 3) Coordinate with community lead to seed the community repost.

Marcus: Will set headline A/B in Buffer (or native API) and schedule variant traffic split. Will monitor first 4 hours and set winner. Also creating 48h pulse report template (engagement, CTR, reg convs, lead quality).

Elena: Ops-bot, please create go/no-go meeting for June 29 09:00 AM PT.

ops-bot: Event created: "Compass Bench go/no-go"  June 29 09:00 AM PT.

Priya: Final caption set locked in Notion. Included short, medium, long; LinkedIn long-form also includes quote pullouts for slides.

Theo: Confirmed uploads and filenames follow convention. Added 1:1 crops for community.

Ken: Sales reviewed Zap permissions and fed back minor field mapping change (company_size -> account_size). Updated recipe and retested.

Elena: Thanks team  last checklist before EOD: Theo confirm assets live (reply), Priya finalize captions (reply), Marcus queue drafts but hold publish, Ken confirm Zap live. Well run go/no-go on June 29 and pick headline winner at T+4h during launch. If blocked ping me directly. :rocket:
